about_the_game:
An infection has struck the body! As the mighty T-Cell, it's your duty to eradicate the invading pathogens!

Consume pathogens to earn mito energy, and use it to purchase upgrades and summon allies in your battle to protect the body. If all your body cells die, it's game over for you.

Utilising squishy softbody physics and hand-drawn graphics, this game will take you on a journey through the body. As you clean up infections, you gather more knowledge about your pathogenic enemies, building an encyclopedia of knowledge. As you obtain more mito, you grow stronger, better able to take on the legions of viruses and bacteria that lie ahead.

Go forth, mighty T-Cell! Save the body from certain demise!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any integrated sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 instructions, with 4 physical cores or more, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
